brief:
Shehab Wire reported that the conflict in Gaza extends beyond military bombardment and destruction to encompass what it describes as a systematic targeting of the territory's intellectual class. The characterization suggests a deliberate campaign reaching deeper than conventional warfare, affecting educators, medical professionals, and other knowledge workers.

The report frames this as a parallel struggle occurring alongside physical destruction, arguing that the loss of Gaza's educated cadre poses long-term threats to the territory's institutional capacity and future reconstruction.

title: Israel targets Gaza's intellectuals and professionals, aid group says
